name: gizza-ai/encoded-payload-decoder
summary: Find and decode base64, hex, and gzip/zlib payloads hidden in a file

tool.description: Scan a file for base64 and hex tokens and gzip/zlib compressed streams embedded anywhere in its bytes, decode/decompress each, and unwrap nested layers (e.g. base64 of gzip of text) up to max_depth (default 3). min_len (default 20) sets the shortest base64/hex run to consider. Each finding reports its encoding, byte offset, nesting depth, and decoded content — printable payloads as text, binaries with a detected file type (e.g. image/png), a hex preview, and surfaced readable strings. Random alphanumeric noise that decodes to nothing meaningful is ignored. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref. Runs locally — the file never leaves the device.

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

min_len.description: Minimum length of a base64/hex token run to treat as a candidate (default 20). Lower finds shorter blobs but more noise.

max_depth.description: How many nested encoding layers to unwrap, e.g. base64 → gzip → text (default 3).
